title: Illumination of Scripture
definition: Illumination of Scripture is the work of the Holy Spirit by which He helps believers understand, receive, and rightly respond to God's Word.
summary: The Spirit opens hearts to understand and embrace the truth God has already revealed in Scripture.
christFocus: Jesus promised the Spirit would guide His people into truth and glorify Him through that truth.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Illumination does not mean the Spirit gives new Scripture or private authority equal to Scripture. It means He opens blind eyes, softens hearts, and helps believers understand the Word God has already given.

The same Spirit who inspired Scripture also helps God's people receive it. He convicts, comforts, corrects, and points the heart to Christ through the written Word.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people read Scripture but remain unmoved, confused, or resistant because the heart needs God's help. Illumination matters because understanding Scripture is not only intellectual; it requires spiritual dependence.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray before and during Bible reading. Ask the Holy Spirit to open your eyes, humble your heart, reveal Christ, expose sin, and lead you into faithful obedience.
